ModMetaData.name: Engine Industries
ModMetaData.author: AOBA
ModMetaData.description:
With the development of industrialization on this planet, the reinvention of the vehicle seems to be a matter of time for everyone.
Prepared for a new era, industrial factions, outlanders, and even pirates are began to gather all the engines they can trade. people has regained the lost knowledge by the orbital traders or themselves, used their bare hands to rebuild the heavy industry that proud of mankind in this outer homeworld.
